evidence.quoted_text:
if not re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{40}', target):
        raise ValueError('target must be a full commit SHA')
evidence.reason: The check at lines 790-791 only validates the shape of a 40-character lowercase hex string, despite the docstring and error saying the target must be a commit SHA. An annotated tag object ID can therefore pass when `--tag` is omitted: Git peels it for `merge-base --is-ancestor`, `ls-tree`, `show`, and checkout, so deployability checks succeed while the recorded target and return value remain the tag object rather than the commit at HEAD. Requiring `git cat-file -t <target>` to equal `commit` before ancestry checks is a small correctness repair enforcing existing intent, not a new requirement.
